TAFE SA is the largest provider of vocational education and training  in SA. Our courses are available in a variety of delivery modes, including full time, part time, online and workplace-based training.

Strong working relationships with business and industry means that courses are designed to give students the skills that employers want. Skills recognition and credit transfer for prior learning mean that students can achieve their goals sooner.
